releaseNotes:
🎬 Reel Shortcode URLs, WhatsApp Photos & Document Vault (v1.3.1):
• 🎬 Exact Reel & Post URLs: Instagram Reels and Posts now save with their canonical shortcode URLs (e.g. instagram.com/reel/DermrwlBNSi/) instead of generic navigation routes, letting you open and watch directly.
• 📷 WhatsApp Photos Saved: Resolved an issue where sender avatars were saved instead of photos; actual downloaded photos are now seamlessly detected, preserved, and displayed.
• 📄 Documents Saved & Viewable: Full support for WhatsApp & Telegram documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, APK, ZIP, etc.) with dedicated document card, file size, direct one-tap opening and sharing.
